prompt_text: Who is a reliable contractor in Joplin MO for a home remodel or repair project?
answer_verbatim:
A few Joplin-area options worth getting quotes from:

- **Shere’s Construction & Handyman** — BBB-accredited with an A+ rating; lists remodeling and general repairs, including drywall, painting, flooring, decks, and fences. **417-385-8899**. [BBB profile](https://www.bbb.org/us/mo/joplin/profile/general-contractor/sheres-construction-handyman-0734-1000009996)
- **GRC General Construction** — BBB-accredited with an A+ rating; describes kitchen and bathroom renovations, flooring, and custom carpentry. **417-499-7424**. [BBB profile](https://www.bbb.org/us/mo/joplin/profile/remodel-contractors/grc-general-construction-0734-1000049263)
- **American Construction, Inc.** — Local general contractor that says it has served the area since 1993 and handles remodeling and related construction work. **417-781-6811**. [Website](https://www.americanconstructionincorporated.com/)

These are leads, not a guarantee of quality—BBB ratings and company claims are only part of the picture. Get at least three written bids, ask for recent references and proof of insurance, and make sure the contract spells out scope, materials, payment schedule, and change orders. For a small repair, Shere’s may be a sensible first call; for a larger remodel, compare GRC and American Construction as well.
